description: This file defines an enumeration 'ShareToAgentSettings' with static methods and properties to manage default instructions for sharing to an agent, utilizing UserDefaults for persistent storage.

methods.name: loadDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Loads the default instruction string from UserDefaults, returns a fallback if none is set or if the value is empty.

methods.name: saveDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Saves a given instruction string to UserDefaults after trimming whitespace; removes the key if the string is empty.
